meta.name: listicle-generator
meta.description: Write "Top N best..." listicle articles for affiliate marketing with mini-reviews, pricing, pros/cons, and CTAs per entry. Triggers on: "write a best of list", "top 10 [category] tools", "best [product category] article", "roundup post", "listicle about [category]", "write a top tools article", "best [N] alternatives to [product]", "product roundup", "write a tools comparison list", "best software for [use case]", "top picks for [category]".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成带评测和CTA的排行榜文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量产出吸引点击的Top榜单文章
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate listicle articles with reviews and CTAs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce top-N listicles for affiliate marketing at scale

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会撰写“Top N Best [类别]”清单体文章，每项含小评、价格、优缺点和购买链接，并包含SEO元数据、比较表、FAQ等完整结构。
howto.when: 当你说出“write a best of list”、“top 10 [类别] tools”、“best [产品类别] article”等短语，或要求写综述文章时触发。

say.text: 写一篇“最佳AI视频工具”的Top 10文章。
say.note: Claude会生成完整文章，包含评价和比较。

say.text: 写一篇“Mailchimp最佳替代品”的清单。
say.note: Claude会生成7款替代品的详细对比。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude writes 'Top N Best [Category]' listicle articles with mini-reviews, pricing, pros/cons, and CTAs per entry, plus SEO metadata, comparison tables, FAQ, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'write a best of list', 'top 10 [category] tools', 'best [product category] article', or ask for a roundup post.

say_en.text: Write a top 10 best AI video tools article.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full listicle with reviews and comparisons.

say_en.text: Write a 'best alternatives to Mailchimp' article.
say_en.note: Claude creates a list of 7 alternatives with detailed comparison.
